summary: Solid 3x3 colored blocks connected to teal pipelines are split into hollow cross (stays) and solid four-star (moves to pipeline's other end); incomplete shapes at pipeline ends are completed with their counterpart.
src: solid 3x3 colored block at one end of a teal pipeline s
dst: the other end of the same teal pipeline d
path: follow teal pipeline from s to reach opposite endpoint d
transform: split s into hollow cross (center + 4 cardinal neighbors) staying at original position, and solid four-star (4 diagonal corners) moving to d
src2: hollow cross or solid four-star already at one end of teal pipeline s
dst2: the other end of the same teal pipeline d
path2: follow teal pipeline from s to reach opposite endpoint d
transform2: place the complementary shape (four-star if cross exists, cross if four-star exists) at d with same color as s
